title: Hybrid post-quantum key exchange in production TLS 1.3: measurement code and data
description:
Data and code accompanying the manuscript Hybrid Post-Quantum Key Exchange in Production TLS 1.3: A Reproducible Measurement of Overhead and Its Implications for Migration (submitted to the ITU Journal on Future and Evolving Technologies, 2026).

1,260 TLS 1.3 handshakes in seven sessions (October and November 2026) comparing classical X25519 with hybrid X25519MLKEM768 against three public endpoints, using OpenSSL 3.5.4 from a qBraid cloud vantage; ClientHello and ServerHello captures; the measurement and analysis notebook; and paired analysis outputs. Results dashboard: https://sarjeant.github.io/pqc-hybrid-tls-handshakes/
